reviews.text: This toner is the definition of "comfort in a bottle." It’s formulated with a Biome Blend to protect the skin barrier and is further enriched with Mugwort and Centella Asiatica for immediate calming effects. What’s interesting are the small nourishing beads suspended in the liquid that melt away as you pat it into your skin. It has a very refreshing, watery consistency that sinks in fast, leaving the face feeling balanced and hydrated after cleansing. It’s perfect for the "7-skin method" or just a quick layer of moisture. It’s a very reliable staple for anyone with sensitive or easily irritated skin looking for a gentle, daily soothing step.
reviews.zh: 呢款化妝水就係「瓶裝嘅舒適感」嘅典範。佢以 Biome Blend 配方保護皮膚屏障，再加入艾草同積雪草，即時舒緩皮膚。最有趣嘅係懸浮喺液體入面嘅細小滋養珠，拍喺皮膚上時會慢慢溶解。質地非常清爽、似水，吸收好快，潔面之後令面部感覺平衡、水潤。好啱用嚟做「七層水護膚法」，或者只係快速疊一層水分。對於敏感或者容易受刺激嘅皮膚，想搵一個溫和、每日舒緩嘅步驟嘅人嚟講，係一款非常可靠嘅必備產品。

reviews.text: so weird that this doesn’t have more reviews! I really like this toner, it is thicker than water but absorbs really well, it has a earthy scent, I think it must be from the mugwort. I think this toner is great for moisture and I have also noticed less breakouts since using this
reviews.zh: 好奇怪，呢款居然冇咁多評論！我真係好鍾意呢款化妝水，佢比水稠少少，但係吸收得好好，有一股泥土嘅香味，我諗應該係艾草嚟嘅。我覺得呢款化妝水補水效果好好，而且我用咗之後，亦都留意到爆痘少咗。

reviews.text:
absolutely broke me out do NOT recommend at all.
2 stars for cute packaging tho🩷.
reviews.zh:
用咗之後真係即刻爆晒痘，完全唔會推薦。
包裝可愛，所以畀兩粒星🩷。

reviews.text:
It. Is a toner that provides deep hydration for all skin types.
Its texture is very watery, it absorbs immediately without leaving any greasiness. It is very nice for the summer months. It has a strong scent, but I like it. It leaves you with a feeling of coolness and freshness.
If you are looking for a toner to feel fresh and rejuvenated but also moisturized, this is for you
reviews.zh:
呢款係一款適合所有膚質嘅深層補水化妝水。
質地好似水咁，即刻吸收，唔會留低任何油膩感。夏天用好舒服。香味好濃，但係我鍾意。用完有種清涼、清新嘅感覺。
如果你想搵一款令皮膚感覺清新、煥發，同時又有保濕嘅化妝水，就係呢款啦。

reviews.text:
Claims: Contains 5 kinds of mineral-rich probiotics and prebiotics in the special “Biome Blend” for dry and sensitive skin. Strengthens the skin barrier, brightens, moisturises, soothes and improves the skin’s water-oil balance. Leaves your skin looking smooth, even toned, clear and radiant.

Key-Ingredients: Mugwort, Lactobacillus Lisate, Lactococcus Ferment Lysate, Saccharomyces Ferment Filtrate, Bifida Ferment Filtrate, Bifida Ferment Lysate & Centella Asiatica

✨My experience: The texture of this toner is rich and watery which sinks into your skin without a problem. Leaves a healthy glow and doesn’t irritate the skin, didn’t break me out either. I really like what this is doing to my skin so far! However the product has a strong earthy scent that can be overpowering if you are sensitive to smells - which is exactly why I won’t be repurchasing because I’m prone to having migraines. Otherwise I’m loving it (a lot) so naturally I’m having mixed feelings about it 😅

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 4/5 - would recommend
reviews.zh:
功效宣稱：含有 5 種礦物豐富嘅益生菌同益生元，屬於特別嘅「Biome Blend」，適合乾性同敏感皮膚。強化皮膚屏障，提亮、保濕、舒緩，並改善皮膚嘅水油平衡。令皮膚睇落光滑、膚色均勻、清透、有光彩。

主要成分：艾草、乳桿菌溶解物、乳酸球菌發酵溶解物、酵母菌發酵過濾物、雙歧桿菌發酵過濾物、雙歧桿菌發酵溶解物同積雪草

✨我嘅體驗：呢款化妝水質地豐富、似水，可以毫無問題咁滲入皮膚。會留低健康嘅光澤，唔會刺激皮膚，亦都冇令我爆痘。到目前為止，我好鍾意佢對我皮膚嘅效果！不過，呢款產品有一股濃烈嘅泥土味，如果你對氣味敏感，可能會覺得受不了——呢個正正係我唔會再買嘅原因，因為我容易偏頭痛。除咗呢點，我好鍾意（真係好鍾意），所以我嘅感受好矛盾 😅

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 4/5 - 會推薦

reviews.text: This toner is comfortable to use, the consistency is a bit thicker than water so it's easy to apply and absorbs well. I haven't really noticed a big difference while using this but also haven't had any negative reactions. Often fermented ingredients are nice and brightening. I just prefer my Anua toner. Only minus is the pretty strong woody, earthy scent from the oils.
reviews.zh: 呢款化妝水好好用，質地比水稠少少，所以易塗抹，吸收都好好。用緊嘅時候，我冇咩特別明顯嘅改變，但係都冇出現任何負面反應。發酵成分通常都好啱用嚟提亮。不過我好似比較鍾意我嘅 Anua 化妝水。唯一缺點係油嘅味好濃，有啲木質同泥土嘅香味。

reviews.text:
I was trialing a few toners, looking for right one
This has a nice texture, sinks in immediately and has a strong but not unpleasant smell, after 20 seconds it leaves a tingley but nice sensation
reviews.zh:
我正試緊幾款化妝水，想搵返啱嘅一款。
呢款質地好好，即刻滲入皮膚，香味好濃，但係唔難聞，塗咗大約二十秒之後，會留低一種刺刺麻麻但好舒服嘅感覺。

reviews.text: Wow this is amazing! I have only used it a few times but my skin has never been better! I feel like acne, scars and spots are less and are faded. Love this toner it, it will now be a staple in my routine!
reviews.zh: 哇，呢款真係好正！我只係用過幾次，但係皮膚從來未試過咁好！我覺得暗瘡、疤痕同斑點都少咗，亦都淡咗。好鍾意呢款化妝水，佢而家會成為我護膚程序入面嘅必備品！
